verdicts.reason: A: The text column shares a clean left edge and the headline > NEW > Try It hierarchy reads well. But the bottle sticks out of the cream circle at both the top and the bottom, the whole composition sits in the upper two-thirds and leaves a large dead orange band across the bottom, and the faint decorative circle at top right floats with no purpose. B: The product is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail jammed into the top-left corner, with a clipped ghost circle behind it, so the key imagery is lost. The NEW badge is blown up to almost CTA size and competes with the headline and the button. The pills are right-aligned while the headline is left-aligned, so nothing shares an edge, and the button crowds the bottom-right margin.
